comparison.objective: Fill a bath while enforcing cold-first and hot-off-first sequencing; candidate tunes an isolated damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Quarter-turn tap operation with coordinated arms, not tool alignment, fastener loosening, collar tuning, or lock verification.
comparison.success_condition: Correct tap sequence and computed fill level; hot running alone causes sticky zero. No indexed spec version and water is not physically simulated.
comparison.reason: Tests safety ordering of controls rather than force-controlled mechanical commissioning.
